'''New Aldera''' was the [[capital/Legends|capital]] [[city/Legends|city]] of the [[planet/Legends|planet]] [[New Alderaan/Legends|New Alderaan]]. It was made to look identical to the city [[Aldera/Legends|Aldera]] that was located on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] prior to [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan’s destruction]].

==History==
===Establishment===
New Aldera was a city on the planet of [[New Alderaan/Legends|New Alderaan]] where thousands of former residents of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] moved to after the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|Destruction of Alderaan]] by the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]]. It was governed by the [[Alderaanian Council]], presumably headed by the [[Alderaan Alliance]]. It was established by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Support Services/Legends|Support Services]], including Lieutenant [[Deeve]].

When the [[Alderaan Alliance]] moved to [[New Alderaan/Legends|New Alderaan]] after [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan's destruction]], New Aldera was built in a similar design and landscape.

===The Battles of New Alderaan===
New Aldera participated in the First and Second Battles of New Alderaan.

====First Battle of New Alderaan====
The '''First Battle of New Alderaan''' was a battle during the [[Hunt for Zsinj|Zsinj campaign]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Taking place around [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], the forces of [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] decimated [[New Alderaan/Legends|New Alderaan]], requiring that planet's evacuation by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

====Second Battle of New Alderaan====
The '''Second Battle of New Alderaan''' was a battle between the reborn [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] forces and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Prior to the battle, the Emperor had sent a contingent of [[Scarab Mark VI assassin droid|Scarab Droids]] to murder [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in his sleep. The Emperor also sent his [[Executor (Imperial rank)|Executor]] [[Xecr Nist]] and his second in command [[Tedryn-Sha]] to kidnap the [[Solo twins]]. Unfortunately for them, [[Jem Ysanna]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] confronted them and killed them while [[Vima-Da-Boda|Vima-da Boda]] destroyed the Scarab Droids.

[[File:Second_battle_of_new_alderaan.jpg|thumb|left|150px|[[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-ATs]] hit by ship-fire.]]
In retaliation for the [[Battle of the Emperor's Citadel|assault on his Citadel at Byss]], the Emperor sent a force of [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-ATs]] to destroy the Rebel settlement at [[New Alderaan/Legends|New Alderaan]]. The AT-ATs were the latest generation of the vehicle class and were equipped with the most powerful Imperial [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] and the new [[X-80 Power Cell]]s. As a result, many buildings and gun emplacements were destroyed. Just as the village was about to be massacred, the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], ''[[Starhook Ten]]'', ''[[Bespin Bandit]]'', ''[[Hyperspace Marauder]]'' and a squadron of X-wings came to the rescue. These new arrivals destroyed several of the AT-ATs. ''Starhook Ten'' landed and opened her cargo bay to the surviving refugees. However, the Rebels were forced to flee and New Aldera was lost to the Empire.

===Reclamation===
After Zsinj's death in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] the New Republic reclaimed the planet, and then again after Palpatine's final death in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]].

At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Lieda Mothma]] recovered on New Alderaan from an unspecified injury or sickness. [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]] would retire to New Aldera, where he died of old age in [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]].
